newsitem.title: CHINA: Heilongjiang Electric raises electricity price.
newsitem.headline: Heilongjiang Electric raises electricity price.

text.p: Heilongjiang Electric Power has raised the price it charges customers for its electricity, a company statement in Friday's Shanghai Securities News said.
The new price of power from the company's No. 1 and No. 2 generating units is 260 yuan per megawatt hour, compared with the former 230 yuan, the statement said.
The rate for power generated by its No. 5 and No. 6 generators has been raised to 270 yuan per megawatt hour from 228.6 yuan, it said.
The price changes took effect on March 25, the statement said.
The company's B shares opened up $0.016 at $0.718 per share and its A shares rose 0.67 yuan to 12.90 yuan at the opening session.
